subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu preserve omitted allowBots as accepting bot-authored messages by default, with loop protection as the safety guard, or require a stricter explicit opt-in before this PR lands?
rationale: The code path is implementable either way, but the default changes live bot admission and loop behavior for existing Feishu deployments and needs maintainer product/upgrade intent.

options.title: Approve Feishu Default Accept
options.body: Preserve the PR's omitted allowBots behavior because current Feishu already lets bot-authored events reach dispatch and the PR adds explicit opt-out plus loop protection.

options.title: Require Restrictive Admission
options.body: Change the default to false or mentions before merge if maintainers want Feishu to match stricter sibling-channel upgrade posture.

options.title: Defer Bot-To-Bot Support
options.body: Pause or close the PR if reliable bot-to-bot conversations are not a desired bundled Feishu plugin direction right now.

recommendation.title: Approve Feishu Default Accept
recommendation.body: Preserve the PR's omitted allowBots behavior because current Feishu already lets bot-authored events reach dispatch and the PR adds explicit opt-out plus loop protection.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shallow-history routing points to Vincent Koc on the central Feishu channel files and generated release/config metadata touched by this PR.
